invariants.description: Zero occurrences of hardcoded room PIN '849201' or 'demo-room' anywhere in src/, including src/lib/rooms/store.ts.
Zero occurrences of static player counts such as 'Daftar siswa (4)' or hardcoded '(4)' student counters in src/.
Brand is strictly 'Exile'; zero occurrences of 'exile.org' or 'exile-org' in src/app or src/components.
Zero occurrences of 'Supabase' or 'Supabase Cloud' in user-facing JSX text across src/app/ and src/components/.
Zero legacy gold/brown hex literals (#CA8A04, #140D08, #1A0F0A, #F5E6D3, #331F14) anywhere in src/.
Every question row in Studio/Question Bank is clickable and expandable, supports live option testing, and allows custom question creation/editing.
invariants.check: E2E browser interaction on /studio question rows and editor modal/drawer

invariants.description: Quizzes, questions, rooms, players, and submissions persist to Supabase; /login and global Settings modal work end-to-end without portal clipping.
invariants.check: API + E2E verification of Supabase persistence, /login, and top-level Settings modal portal

cases.title: Pre-seeded demo room 849201 left in store.ts while removed from page.tsx
cases.artifact_summary: Developer removed '849201' from src/app/page.tsx but kept demoPin = '849201' and id = 'demo-room-849201' in src/lib/rooms/store.ts.
cases.rationale: Any presence of 849201 or demo-room in src/ (including store fallbacks) violates Zero Hardcoding.

cases.title: Promotional 'Supabase Cloud' badge in Studio/Host footer
cases.artifact_summary: UI displays 'Tersinkronisasi dengan Supabase Cloud' in user-facing JSX status bar.
cases.rationale: User-facing copy must never advertise backend vendors like Supabase Cloud; brand is strictly Exile.

cases.title: Unclickable static question rows in Question Bank table
cases.artifact_summary: TanStack table renders question stems and concept badges, but clicking a row does not expand options, rationales, or live option testing.
cases.rationale: Every question row must be clickable/expandable with live option testing and custom editing.

cases.title: Settings Modal rendered inside sticky backdrop-blur header without portal
cases.artifact_summary: Settings modal is mounted as a child of the sticky header (which uses backdrop-blur-md), trapping fixed positioning inside the header bounding box.
cases.rationale: Modals must use document.body portals or BoardUI Modal so they never clip inside a backdrop-blur ancestor.

cases.title: Clean BoardUI implementation with dynamic rooms, persisted quizzes, and Exile branding
cases.artifact_summary: All rooms dynamically generated and stored in Supabase, 0 hardcoded PINs or player counts, BoardUI components & semantic tokens in Light/Dark mode, clickable/editable questions, and clean Exile branding.
cases.rationale: Meets all Layer 1 deterministic invariants and Layer 2 Frontier quality criteria.
